title: Sepulchre boss, wormhole visuals, Far Shot points

sections.heading: New
items: A new level-20 boss, the Sepulchre, arrives carried by four Pallbearers who orbit it, each tolling a beat and firing from a different direction.
Pallbearers foreshadow the fight throughout Act II, making slow passes through the sky before the boss wave.
Wormholes are redrawn as gravitational lenses bending starlight into arcs, rings, and spiral wisps instead of the old red-wound look.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Far Shot now pays a flat +50 points shown on the field, instead of granting extra rhythm.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Sepulchre Pallbearer wake timing and release behavior corrected.
Sepulchre fight pacing improved and its final volley is more clearly telegraphed.

title: Fix replay export: audio mix, video framerate

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Exported replay videos no longer have sounds (bass pulse, shots, explosions) that gradually fade out over the course of the movie.
Exported replay audio now matches the in-game mix volume and dynamics instead of sounding quieter with sharper transients.
Exported replay videos are now a fixed 60 fps instead of a variable ~119 fps, halving file size and improving compatibility.

title: Far Shot bonus and seam-stable trajectory preview

sections.heading: New
items: Far Shot combo: hitting a target 2+ quarter-note beats after firing awards bonus rhythm points, with staggered flash effects.
Shots landing 3+ beats out display a 'N BEATS OUT' label and trigger a special drift burst and boom in the Far Shot hue.
Trajectory preview dots now stay stable as targets cross the screen edge instead of jumping or vanishing.

sections.heading: Tuning
items: Far Shot rhythm payout now counts only the extra beats beyond the first, so a 2-beat shot pays +1 and a 3-beat shot pays +2.

title: Drift-lock visuals and wormhole colour fixes

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Drift-lock flourish (dashed ring, soundwaves, flash, pulse) now appears at a consistent size for standard bullets, no longer dwarfed by the bomb's larger version.
Wave-skip wormholes left by killed aliens now render in the standard portal colour instead of a separate emerald tint.

title: Aim hint and replay button reliability fixes

sections.heading: New
items: A one-time targeting hint now appears when you fire in rhythm but keep missing: a pulsing ring blooms around the lead reticule with on-screen text guiding you to aim ahead of the asteroid, not at it.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Replay buttons no longer disappear on leaderboard rows right after you upload a run — stale cache layers no longer hide a replay you just saved.
Your post-run standings view is now fetched after your replay uploads, so it correctly shows a play button for your new run.
Replay encoding failures are now logged instead of silently leaving your run without an uploadable replay.

title: Phone support, audio fixes, and prong tuning

sections.heading: New
items: Touch controls now include a fire button, making the game fully playable on phones and tablets.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Replays no longer go missing when you take longer than one loop to enter your name on the game-over screen.
Stacked sound effects no longer distort or clip when many things happen at once.

sections.heading: Tuning
items: Prong fan spread narrowed to 30° per prong for tighter shot grouping.
Game sounds load faster at startup — initial download drops from ~2.6 MB to ~560 KB.

title: Dual key bindings: arrows and WASD both work by default

sections.heading: New
items: Each control action now supports two bindings — a primary and an alternate.
Arrow keys and WASD are both active out of the box with no setup required.
The controls screen now shows two key chips per action, each independently rebindable or clearable.
New intro hint lines added to the tip rotation.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Existing saved bindings are automatically upgraded to add the WASD alternates where they do not conflict with your custom keys.

title: Varied wording for rhythm-miss hints

sections.heading: Changed
items: The hint shown when you miss a hit on beat now rotates through several different phrasings to keep the feedback fresh across a session.

title: Wraiths, bonus lives, comet SFX & Google sign-in

sections.heading: New
items: Wraith enemies now have full sound effects: hit, lunge, scream, and death.
Earning a bonus life triggers a full-screen flash and a new choral sound.
Comets now burst apart at end of life instead of quietly warping away.
Comet destruction plays distinct sounds depending on whether you shot it.
Sign in with Google to claim your callsign so only you can submit under it.
Signed-in pilots accumulate persistent lifetime stats visible on the leaderboard.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Rapid same-sound playback no longer causes audio clipping or pileup.

title: Citadel asteroids, wave-skip portals, boss laser overhaul

sections.heading: New
items: Citadel asteroids appear in later waves — massive armoured fortresses with a ship-shaped escape hole; fly inside while the shell is phased out and shoot the inner wall to destroy them.
Defeating aliens can now open wave-skip portals; fly into one to jump ahead several waves and re-emerge with a return portal.
New warm-up waves ease newer players into the game with single-target encounters before the full field spawns.
Streaks now have their own shimmer sounds and music layer.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Boss laser timing overhauled: the eye now has a longer aim windup followed by a visible pre-fire surge before it fires, giving more time to read and dodge the shot.
Boss hemisphere armour is now directional — the freshly-cut flat face takes full damage while the rounded outer shell still deflects weak shots.
Bonus life threshold now doubles after each award.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Audio engine overhauled to pre-bake all synthesized drones and sound effects, reducing CPU load and eliminating potential audio glitches during gameplay.

title: Crystal asteroid tuning

sections.heading: Tuning
items: Small solid crystals now take 2 hits to destroy.

title: Asteroid damage reduction tuned down

sections.heading: Tuning
items: Asteroids absorb slightly less damage when hit.

title: Streak system, beat-accurate laser, torus collision fixes

sections.heading: New
items: Rhythm streaks now reward escalating score bonuses for each successive on-beat shot, displayed as orbiting comet-sparks around the reticule.
Wave summary now shows your longest streak instead of total streak shots.
A new drain chime plays over the wave summary screen.
Laser charge dot accents now fire sample-accurately on the beat instead of arriving a frame late.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Asteroid knockback no longer stacks from repeated hits or armored deflections — momentum transfers once per bullet.
Boss beam, shockwave, and collision detection now correctly handle targets near or across the world seam.
Comet and alien trails no longer draw a screen-spanning streak when the entity wraps around the map edge.
Fuel orbs and canisters now wrap properly instead of occasionally blinking out.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Leaderboard now sorts by score by default instead of rhythm.
Tutorial side-thrust controls now display SHIFT key label for clarity.

title: Hints expanded, meteors now expire, controls auto-sync

sections.heading: New
items: Added new atmospheric hint messages shown at the start of a run.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Stray meteors that lagged behind a shower now despawn instead of lingering indefinitely.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Control key display in the instructions panel now stays automatically in sync with actual bindings.

title: Comets, fuel orbs, and gem visual overhaul

sections.heading: New
items: Fuel orbs now drop from gold ore that cracks open without an upgrade in Fuel Mode — fly through the cyan tumbling orb to refill your reserve.
Comets now wrap around the map boundaries instead of drifting off-screen, keeping them visible for their full 30-second lifespan before warping out.
Comets depart through a warp portal at a fixed 30-second timer rather than fading out when they reach a screen edge.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Gems have a new look: a faceted brilliant-cut diamond with shaded crown and pavilion facets, a rough chipped shadow side, and crisp sparkle seams instead of a wireframe octahedron.
Comets no longer fade to invisible before leaving — they stay bright and dive through a departure portal as their exit animation.
The shield option has been removed from powerup canisters.

title: Torus Ring, Super-Laser, and Farshot rename

sections.heading: New
items: A new Torus Ring enemy appears in later waves: a mechanical ring that splits into orbiting arc fragments when destroyed.
Flying through the energy threads between torus arc fragments charges a one-shot super-laser that fires a screen-spanning beam.
The laser upgrade now shows a dash-mark reticule along the firing line for each reachable charge tier.
Alien bullets now time out after a fixed duration instead of flying forever.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Bullets now inherit the ship's full velocity, so projectiles and the laser reticule aim accurately while moving.

sections.heading: Changed
items: The 'Longshot' powerup has been renamed to 'Farshot'.
Slow-motion duration has been halved for tighter gameplay pacing.
Ship velocity is now capped at max speed for more controlled movement.

title: Comets and aliens now warp out through departure portals

sections.heading: New
items: Comets that time out now dive through a swirling departure portal instead of fading away.
Aliens that cross the screen now warp out through a portal instead of vanishing off the edge.
Warping-out comets and aliens are intangible — bullets and the ship no longer interact with them.
Background ecliptic stars now orbit the pulsar's tilted plane alongside the planets, giving the sky more depth.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Aliens now appear in dark blood-red instead of deep violet.
Comets now spawn from the visible screen edge and move faster, making them harder to farm for on-beat combos.
Drift Shot combo now shows two staged numbers climbing one step at a time; the damage multiplier label only reappears when you beat your best tier for the run.
Alien bullets no longer time out — they persist until they hit or are otherwise cleared.

title: Richer starfield and new scroll camera mode

sections.heading: New
items: The default camera now locks your ship to screen center and scrolls the entire arena around you, so you are never near a hard edge.
Two additional experimental camera views (2×2 tiled and 3×3 silhouette-edge) can be switched live with number keys 1–4; an on-screen label shows the active mode.
The starfield now features a diagonal Milky Way band with denser star clusters, nebula clouds, and a handful of prominent bright foreground stars with diffraction glints.
Background layers (nebula, dust, star field) each scroll at their own parallax depth, giving the arena a clear sense of 3D space.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Starfield and parallax layers no longer jolt or snap when the ship crosses a wrap seam.
Tutorial control-hint glyphs now fade individually the moment each specific key is pressed, rather than all at once.

title: Drift bonuses, player profiles, and replay fixes

sections.heading: New
items: Drift shots now reward tier-based damage multipliers with distinct popup colors showing your bonus.
The leaderboard now includes a personal profile view showing your top-50 runs across score, rhythm, wave, and recent categories.
After submitting a score, the leaderboard shows your rank in context with the scores around yours.
Bodies, bullets, and gems now render smoothly as they wrap across screen edges.
Tutorial controls now mention side thrust mechanics.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Replays now reproduce wave transitions, score drain, and bonus lives on the correct frames instead of desyncing after wave 1.
Replay beat timing is fully restored from the original run, so on-beat judgments match the recording frame-for-frame.
Ship respawn timing during replays now matches live play exactly, preventing drift after each death.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Mothlight Hour music layers updated with improved audio quality and a new full-length mix.

title: Gems, Laser Shot, Spectrum Visualizer & Rhythm Tuning

sections.heading: New
items: Collectible Gems now drop from gold-bearing asteroids and can be shot on-beat for points or a powerup, or picked up directly.
Burst Gem asteroids explode into a fan of fast-flying Gem blades — dodge or shoot them on-beat to claim the reward.
Gem swarm events send a flock of fast Gems streaking across the field as a timed rhythm challenge.
New Laser Shot powerup lets you activate laser capabilities during gameplay.
A spectrum visualizer now pulses around the pulsar; press keys 1–5 to switch between visualization modes.
The reticule now shows a guidance arrow orbiting toward the nearest first-beat rhythm dot, plus a lock-on pulse when hovering over one.
Wave bodies flash brighter on the beat for improved rhythm feedback.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Score submission status message now correctly indicates when a replay is available.

sections.heading: Tuning
items: Fast asteroid shards are throttled to a calmer drift until you build a combo of 4, then snap to full speed.
Losing your combo now shows a subtitle explaining why the rhythm was broken.
Moving gems are included as reticule targeting hints with trajectory preview lines.

title: Huge asteroids, gold gems, warbles, laser charge & replays

sections.heading: New
items: Huge asteroids now appear — larger and tougher than large, they shatter into varied fragment combinations.
Gold gem asteroids (medium and big tiers) spawn as chunky cut diamonds; destroying one bursts it into a fan of fast gold diamond shards.
Gem swarm events send a flock of gold-crystal rocks streaking across the field, rewarding quick shooting with upgrade drops.
Warble asteroids now phase in and out on the beat — they turn intangible while dimmed, letting bullets pass clean through.
Laser charging now builds through multiple tiers with sustained sound effects and visual crackle; releasing a charged shot triggers a full-screen flash.
Replays can now be scrubbed with a timeline control — pause, change playback speed, or seek to any moment with arrow keys or the on-screen bar.
Glass prisons now release a brood of 2–4 wraiths instead of a single one when broken.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Cathedral debris (bell, glass shards, keystones) now appears dark and unlit — the stained glass has gone cold.
Leaderboard top-pilots view now scans deeper to ensure a diverse spread of pilots is shown even when one pilot dominates the top scores.

sections.heading: Tuning
items: Alien bullets are now significantly larger, improving visibility during combat.
Prong upgrade now stacks — each pickup adds an additional prong bullet rather than simply toggling the effect.

title: Improved beat timing feel and title update

sections.heading: Changed
items: The game title is now "Pulsar" instead of "Pulsar Drift".
The background beat now plays a short transient tick at the moment of each pulse, making the beat feel crisper and more precisely timed.
Background beat audio files have been updated with improved sound data.

title: Improved audio beat timing accuracy

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Background beat pulses now schedule to the audio hardware in advance, preventing audible drift when a frame runs long.
Beats stay correctly timed during slow-motion gameplay instead of slipping with frame boundaries.

title: Boss laser, beat fragments, and damage hint

sections.heading: New
items: Boss laser aim now rotates like a turret — circling the boss lets you outrun the sweep instead of being snapped onto.
Destroyed boss hull plates and iris shards pulse on the beat with glowing blooms, keeping the rhythm alive as the planet breaks apart.
Beat-active boss debris produces heavier, wider lightning arcs than ordinary Bassteroid splinters.
A red 'INSUFFICIENT DAMAGE / GAIN MORE RHYTHM' tip now appears the first time a shot glances off an armoured rock.
Boss debris carries a Resonance bounty — cashing the field while fragments pulse pays out more than standard small pieces.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Entering the boss wave while a halo was already active now correctly transitions to the boss music instead of staying on the random track.
Bassteroids now always break into the same recognisable pieces — fragments are authored per shape, never random, so splits are consistent and stutter-free.
Boss laser beam fires along the telegraphed aim line rather than snapping to the ship's position at the last moment.

title: Boss rework, meteor showers, and cathedral asteroids

sections.heading: New
items: Meteor showers now appear as fast-moving flocks of meteors with their own sound effects and scoring.
The boss fires a sustained sweeping beam attack from its eye.
Bell asteroids now shatter into carved debris pieces: keystones, glass shards, column drums, and rubble blocks.
Bell asteroids now come in five distinct cathedral archetypes — lancet wall, rose facade, spire tower, arcade, and buttress ruin — each with unique visuals.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Boss attack cycle extended to 8 seconds; the laser fires on beat 8 with a more visible windup.
Boss targeting reticule no longer locks onto the boss during its dormant approach phase.
Boss eye bolts now aim more accurately using the last tracked targeting line.

sections.heading: Tuning
items: Bass asteroid halo gap tightened from 14px to 8px for a cleaner outline.
Boss spawn speed reduced for better pacing and visual impact.

title: New boss music, echo bonus, and bullet deflection

sections.heading: New
items: Two new boss-fight music tracks — Vigil and Knell — replace the old boss theme.
A new post-boss haunting track, Spectral Toll, plays after defeating the boss.
Solid crystals now deflect weak bullets instead of absorbing them, with particle effects showing the bounce.
A new Echo bonus tracks bass hits on asteroids and adds to your score multiplier.
Bass lightning arcs now visually connect bass-echo hits during gameplay.
Rhythm bonus popups appear when you hit shots in time with the beat.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Music stems now load gradually at run start instead of all at once, reducing beat stutter in the opening seconds.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Scores are now formatted consistently across the HUD, game over screen, and wave summary.
The synthwave music layer has been retuned with a new upper-register pluck echo cascade for better presence in the mix.

title: Touch controls added for mobile play

sections.heading: New
items: On-screen rotation and thrust buttons now appear on touch devices during gameplay.
Beat Calibration screen now supports tapping the on-screen ring on touch devices instead of pressing Space.
Leaderboard layout is optimised for small screens.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Beat Calibration tap timing is more accurate on touch devices — input registers on finger-down rather than finger-up.

title: New boss music, visual effects, and cathedral asteroids

sections.heading: New
items: A dedicated boss-fight music track (brooding brass and heartbeat sub-bass) now plays during the boss encounter.
Three new post-boss atmospheric music tracks cycle through levels 11–19: a cathedral hymn, a lost-transmission ghost, and a submerged requiem.
Boss laser shots now render as a bright beam-streak with a white-hot core and perpendicular lens flare.
Post-break boss plasma balls display as larger charged spheres with a crimson corona and fade out gracefully.
Bell asteroids now display as detailed cathedral wall fragments with gothic lancet windows, stained glass, rose medallions, and weathered masonry.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Wraith lunges are now beat-aligned and staggered between enemies so they don't all charge at the same time.
The Pulsar features improved Bailey's Beads and diamond-ring visual effects during close passes.

title: Boss battle, glass prisons, and leaderboard dates

sections.heading: New
items: The level-10 boss now has a multi-phase encounter: a dormant reveal period, a tracking eye-core that fires plasma bolts, and a full shatter sequence leaving hemispheres, plates, iris shards, and an ember.
Glass prison asteroids appear from level 11 — tough angular shells containing a captive wraith that escapes when the prison is destroyed.
Wraits pursue the ship, slither side to side, and occasionally lunge; they must be finished off after breaking free.
Boss plasma bolts render as chunky glowing orbs distinct from normal alien stingers.
Leaderboard now supports sorting scores by date, with relative and exact timestamps shown for each entry.

sections.heading: Changed
items: The beat-combo threshold for certain rhythm effects has been raised from 16 to 32, increasing the challenge.
Music layer audio in the Outer Wilds and Cinematic tracks has been updated with improved stems and smoother volume arcs.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Leaderboard layout is more consistent, with better column spacing and date column alignment.

title: Dev Log viewer and background beat improvements

sections.heading: New
items: The Dev Log popup now lists multiple entries, each expandable by clicking.
Dev Log entries can be collapsed and expanded individually for easier browsing.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Background beat pulse is now stronger and more consistent throughout gameplay.

title: Trajectory preview, intro hints, and invulnerability fixes

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Ship trajectory preview now fades out immediately after you stop thrusting instead of lingering as visual noise.
Trajectory preview no longer gets stuck visible after intro overlay sequences.
Players are now correctly vulnerable once the calibration intro hands off to live play.

sections.heading: Changed
items: One of the intro hint messages has been updated.

title: Intro sequence, visual polish, and performance improvements

sections.heading: New
items: A beat-locked intro overlay now plays at the start of each run, fading in gameplay tips before revealing the world.
First-time players see a 'Latency calibrated' confirmation screen followed by three gameplay hints and a closing 'Become one with the Pulsar' line.
Returning players after 4+ hours see the full three-hint pilot's log; same-day re-entries get a lighter single-hint opener.
Hints rotate each session so the same three lines are not repeated back-to-back.
Pulsar now displays richer nebula, flare, glow, core, and pinprick visual effects.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Pulsar eclipse flare no longer incorrectly blooms when totality is zero.
Target lock hum now fades out quickly when the reticule leaves a target instead of lingering.

sections.heading: Tuning
items: Target lock animation and sound use a smooth sine swell instead of a sharp pop, keeping your ear on the song beat.
Lock fill animation and cue are now snapped to the song's beat grid for tighter audio-visual sync.
Lock proximity zone is tightened so drift-shot credit only triggers on near-direct overlap.
Canvas shadow blur removed globally, improving rendering performance across all game objects.

title: Laser Shot, new music tracks, and visual polish

sections.heading: New
items: New Laser Shot powerup lets you charge up a powerful beam and release it on the beat for massive damage.
Four new background music tracks added to the rotation: vaporwave, outer-wilds folk, dawn/crystal, and synthwave styles.
Bullets now flash when they cross your reticule on-beat, giving clear visual confirmation of on-beat hits.
A one-time hint appears the first time you complete a Drift Lock, explaining the x2 damage mechanic.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Asteroids spawning at screen edges no longer travel at shallow angles that caused visual glitches.
Gameplay clock now stays tightly synced to the music, reducing drift between the beat and audio.

sections.heading: Changed
items: First-wave asteroids now materialize in a ring around the player instead of appearing from fixed positions.
Reticule beat pulse is significantly stronger, making rhythm timing easier to read at a glance.
Kick drum and bass sounds updated for more presence and improved audio quality.
Background music tracks updated with improved audio quality across all styles.

title: Replay fidelity improvements

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Replays now correctly reproduce wave 1 layout when the tutorial or veteran pilot setting differs between the recorder and the viewer.
Replays now use the original player's control bindings, so recorded inputs map to the correct actions even if the viewer has rebound their keys.
Returning to the title screen after watching a replay no longer leaves the viewer stuck with the recorded pilot's key bindings.

title: Improved visuals, audio, and enemy behavior

sections.heading: New
items: Drift bonus popup now shows a '2× DAMAGE' subtitle the first time you pull off a Drift Shot in a run.
The starfield and background planets now share a coherent camera with subtle parallax and a slow roll as you progress.
The boss planetoid is now visually distinct with an oblong silhouette and updated eclipse corona effects.
Updated in-game music tracks with new orchestral cello and choir layers for later rounds.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Alien saucers now reliably cross the screen instead of clipping a corner and exiting from the same edge they entered.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Replay saving is now a checkbox preference in the score entry form instead of a one-time button.
Slow-motion effect is less extreme, making slow-mo sequences feel snappier.
Bassteroids are less durable, reducing the bullet budget required to clear them.

title: Replays, per-channel audio, and visual overhaul

sections.heading: New
items: Gameplay replays can now be saved and uploaded after posting a high score — watch your run from the leaderboard.
Leaderboard entries show a replay button when a recording is available.
Audio settings now have separate volume sliders for Base Pulse, Sound Effects, Music, and Vocals.
Rhythm latency calibration has moved into the Audio settings tab for easier access.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Background planets are now backlit: their bodies sit in deep shadow with a thin crescent rim-light on the pulsar-facing side, plus a corona flare during eclipses.
Planets now render in front of the pulsar disc and nebula, so they correctly occlude it when crossing.

sections.heading: Tuning
items: White bullet (super-boosted) combo threshold raised from 8 to 12 — harder to reach but the yellow halo tier now lasts longer.

title: Prong aiming improvements and Pilot's Log vocals option

sections.heading: New
items: Added a setting to disable Pilot's Log vocals while still unlocking log entries normally.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Prong shots now correctly show hover rings on both prong reticules, and drift-lock can trigger off either prong.
Aim disc tick lengths now render correctly on each individual prong reticule.

title: Aliens now arc and drift off-screen instead of wrapping

sections.heading: Changed
items: Aliens fly a curving, arcing path across the field instead of moving in straight lines.
Aliens no longer wrap around the screen edges — they drift off and disappear.
Alien engine drone sounds stop correctly when an alien leaves the screen.
Prong reticule now properly anchors the drift-shot bonus to the first prong angle.

title: Solid crystal gem drops and fragment changes

sections.heading: Changed
items: Solid crystals now use weighted probabilities for gem drops: 60% chance of 0 gems, 25% for 1, 10% for 2, and 5% for 3.
Destroying a large solid crystal now produces 2 fragments instead of 3.
The in-game bonus label has been renamed from "DRIFT BONUS" to "DRIFT SHOT".

title: Dev log button and aim disc visual improvements

sections.heading: New
items: A new "dev log" button in the overlay lets you open and close the latest dev log entry at any time.
An indicator dot appears on the dev log button when there is an unread entry.
The dev log panel can now be dismissed with the Escape key.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Aim disc color now correctly matches your ship's trajectory chevron color.

title: Solid crystals, manta aliens, and stinger bullets

sections.heading: New
items: Solid crystal asteroids appear in waves — tougher than normal rocks, they shatter into fast fragments and drop collectible gems.
Alien ships now sport a sleek manta-ray silhouette with curved wings, cephalic horns, glowing structural ribs, and an animated whip tail.
Big aliens fire an 8-shot fan burst in a wide arc, then pause before the next volley.
Alien bullets now appear as slim stinger darts instead of round blobs.
The big alien's fire sound uses a sampled electric guitar.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Ship trajectory preview now shows directional chevrons instead of dots for clearer heading indication.
Aim disc rendering distinguishes between primary and secondary weapon slots.
Gold crystals shatter on ship contact with an updated sound effect.
